details: We included in this the test reports from NASA that we have a small chance of sustaining life on Mars, but the medical conditions are difficult, such as extreme heat and cold. We included a lot of content in this story.A research spacecraft crashes on Mars, one of the crew members is thrown far away and cannot be found by the others. However, a spacecraft is sent from Earth to rescue the others. He collects as many pieces of the crashed plane as he can and builds a device to send a signal, based on his experience. He will be able to send that signal after a while. We used artificial intelligence for this. And we got some software support.
